parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence is documented, and no universal-exposure measure appears — no facility ban, custody rule, strip-search or border-marker practice is evidenced. The worst documented feature is tier 3: a 2023 governmental finding of pervasive social and religious intolerance, status treated as taboo, shunning on disclosure, plus public-morality provisions (ss.353/354) whose reach is unbounded by any case law and which authorities may use against publicly read same-sex conduct. Recourse is thin: no SOGI anti-discrimination law beyond employment, no service-refusal remedy, and a complaint channel not shown to work, in a state whose prisons and rule of law are themselves criticised. That places it below the 0.55 tier (where recurring visitor harms are documented) but above the 0.35 tier, whose dossiers actually document institutional exclusion or police extortion. Sparse documentation is treated as a sourcing gap, not safety.
